item.title: Ben Ferguson Goes Absolutely Wild in the Backcountry in ‘CINDERS’
item.description: Ben Ferguson decided a few years ago that he'd like to focus more on backcountry riding. In CINDERS, a new snowboarding film, he does just that.

item.title: Seal Beach Resident Identified as One of Three Hikers Found Dead on Mt. Baldy
item.description: Casanova's body was found Monday with two other hikers whose identities the department has not shared yet. He reportedly fell 500 feet near Devil's Backbone.

item.title: Would You Surf in Rain Like This?
item.description: Surfing after a hard rain in Southern California isn't recommended. But if the waves are good, and the lineup is empty, would you surf in rain like this?

item.title: Ben Gravy Waited Three Hours in Freezing Weather For a Proper Freshwater Tube
item.description: Ben Gravy has waited a decade for a freshwater tube this good on the Great Lakes. And you know what they say: "good things come to those who wait."

item.title: Watch Humpback Whales ‘Mug’ a Whale-Watching Boat Off Maui
item.description: A family vacationing in Maui were "mugged" by a pair of what were likely juvenile humpback whales while they were on a whale-watching expedition.

item.title: Second Body Found in Search for Tourists Lost at Sea in Indonesia
item.description: Rescuers have recovered a second body in the search for a Spanish soccer coach and three of his children that went missing after a tour boat sank in Indonesia.

item.title: Telluride Announces Partial Reopening, Makes Revised Offer to Ski Patrol Union
item.description: The ski patrol union was quick to respond publicly on Saturday and contend that "they did not bring more money to the table, they just moved it around."

item.title: Giant Phantom Jellyfish Filmed in Super-Rare Footage From Antarctica
item.description: Sea monsters are myths. There no real sea monsters in reality, but reality sure does come close. Take the giant phantom jellyfish as an example.

item.title: The Utah Avalanche Center Is Trying to Identify 2 People Caught in Large Unreported Slide
item.description: Utah Avalanche Center officials believe the skiers involved in the unreported slide had likely ducked a rope at Brighton in order to access the backcountry.

item.title: Hiker Killed by Mountain Lion in Colorado First in 25 Years
item.description: A hiker was killed by a mountain lion in Colorado last week, marking the first mountain lion-related fatality in the state in over 25 years.
